text: {"question":"How does the inclusion of DESI DR2 BAO data affect the inferred value of Neff compared to recent CMB datasets?","reference_answer":"DESI DR2 BAO data shifts the central value of Neff toward the Standard Model prediction of 3.044, reducing the preference for Neff < 3.044 that recent CMB measurements (e.g., ACT) suggest at about the 2σ level."}
